summary_en: Year-end dividend for FY2027 (ending March 2027) raised from 23 yen to 50 yen per share, an increase of 27 yen. Annual dividend guidance revised to 73 yen per share from 46 yen, reflecting upward revision of full-year net profit to 3,900 million yen from 2,300 million yen.
title_en: Notice Regarding Differences between 2027 Fiscal Year Second Quarter (Interim Period) Consolidated Business Performance Forecasts and Actual Results, Revision of Full-Year Consolidated Business Performance Forecasts, and Modification of Dividend Forecasts (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Japan Cash Machine Co., Ltd. revised its dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The interim (second quarter) dividend remains at 23 yen per share, while the year-end dividend is raised from 23 yen to 50 yen per share, representing an increase of 27 yen. Consequently, the full-year dividend guidance has been increased from 46 yen per share to 73 yen per share.

The dividend increase reflects a significant upward revision of the company's full-year consolidated earnings forecast. Net profit attributable to parent company shareholders is now projected at 3,900 million yen, up 1,600 million yen or 69.6 percent from the previous forecast of 2,300 million yen. Operating profit is expected to reach 4,900 million yen, an increase of 1,900 million yen or 63.3 percent from the prior forecast.

The company attributes the improved earnings outlook to robust sales of its flagship products in the global gaming market and the impact of tariff refunds received during the fiscal year related to U.S. tariff measures. The company maintains a dividend policy targeting a consolidated payout ratio of 50 percent or higher, balancing profit growth through strategic initiatives with stable shareholder returns.
